Name: Pad and Pin Retexture for Help Wanted - Together
Author: myxvcx
Description:
[left][size=4][b]This mod is only a graphic for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45081]Help Wanted - Together[/url] mod, original by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25888550]semper1dem[/url].[/b][/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][b]Installation:[/b][/left]
[left]Unpack the "[CP] Help Wanted - Together Pad&Pin Retexture" folder into your stardew valley mod(Stardew Valley/game/Mods/) folder.[/left]
[left]Or use a mod manager like stardrop.
[/left]
[left]This version(1.0) is known to be compatible with Help Wanted - Together 0.1.2, Stardew Valley 1.6.15, Contentpatcher 2.9.1, and SMAPI 4.5.2. Other versions may be compatible as well but untested. [/left]
[left][/left]
[size=4][b].

[/b](For pad and pin retexture for More Quests see: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53754]Pad and Pin Retexture for More Quests[/url])
(For pad and pin retexture for the base version of help wanted see: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14953]Pad and Pin Retexture for Help Wanted[/url])[/size]
[size=4][b]
Credits:[/b][/size]
